name: Rockefeller State Park Preserve! 🥾🍂
transitText: Metro-North Hudson Line to Tarrytown, then rideshare
locationName: Rockefeller State Park Preserve Visitor Center
thingsToKnow: 6.7mi loop hike, 2.5-3 hours; costumes welcome. By MetroNorth/rideshare: meet Grand Central's info booth by 8:30am, 8:52am train to Tarrytown (arrives 9:45am), then rideshare to the Visitor Center by 10:10am. By car: meet at the Visitor Center by 10:10am. Hike starts 10:20am, finishes by 1:30pm. Costs beyond the free entry: MetroNorth ~$20.50 round trip, rideshare ~$10/person each way, $6/vehicle park entry fee.
